say:1:1322529001:1.text: This streetlamp keeps flashing in my face, it's blinding! Fixing this thing is a nightmare!
say:1:1322529001:1.source_cn: 这路灯一闪一闪的，快把我晃瞎了！修这玩意儿真是个又费力...

say:2:1322529002:1.text: Got time for a game of Century Quest? I need a break before I go blind from all this.
say:2:1322529002:1.source_cn: 你有空吗，咱们来盘百物牌？我得好好放松一下我的眼睛！
say:2:1322529002:1.male: Got time for a game of Century Quest? I need a break before I go blind from all this.
say:2:1322529002:1.female: Got time for a game of Century Quest? I need a break before I go blind from all this.
